name: Cafe Koma
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Koma in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland Tirol**, our cozy café invites you to indulge in the finest local flavors. Whether you're seeking a moment of relaxation after a day of exploring the stunning **Tiroler Alpen**, or you're craving a hearty breakfast before hitting the slopes in **Innsbruck** or the surrounding ski resorts, Café Koma is your perfect retreat.

Start your day with a steaming cup of **Tiroler Bergkaffee** and a freshly baked **Kaiserschmarrn**, drizzled with apricot jam and a sprinkle of powdered sugar. For those with a sweet tooth, our **Apfelstrudel** and **Sachertorte** are legendary—just like the stories of **Tirol’s** imperial past.

After a day of adventure—whether it’s hiking through the **Zillertal**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or soaking in the thermal waters of **Längenfeld**—return to Café Koma for a warm **Glühwein** or a creamy **Vanilleeis**. Our menu also features artisanal **Tiroler Speck** and homemade **Käsekrainer**, perfect for sharing with friends.

Experience the warmth of **Tiroler Gastfreundschaft** in every cup, every bite. We look forward to welcoming you in our café, where tradition meets modern charm.

**Café Koma – Where Tirol’s flavors come to life!**
